instruction.text: You are facing two photographs which are on the shelf. Turn to your right. Exit the room, and towards your right you can see few steps. Go up the steps and towards your right there is a passage. Go near the piano. Take a right and you can see an entry towards the right side of the piano, which leads to a small space. Get inside the space. Now, you can see you are standing in between the cupboards which has few books and other items in it and this is the end point.
